::: {.lead}
We explore how artificial intelligence can enhance teaching and learning in higher education, with a focus on intelligent tutoring systems, adaptive learning, and human-AI collaboration.
:::

## What We Do

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### [Research](research/index.qmd)

Investigating intelligent tutoring systems that adapt to individual learners and provide meaningful feedback grounded in cognitive science.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### [Teaching](teaching/index.qmd)

Courses and programs on AI in education, including continuing education at BFH and the CAS Hochschuldidaktik.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### [Workshops](workshops/index.qmd)

Hands-on workshops covering generative AI tools, prompt engineering, and practical applications for educators.
:::

:::

## About

Virtuelle Akademie is part of [Bern University of Applied Sciences](https://www.bfh.ch/). We are members of the [BeLEARN](https://belearn.swiss/) research network advancing the science of learning through interdisciplinary collaboration.

[Learn more about our team](about/index.qmd)
